dt_ladder.method: observed order p = ln(e21/e32)/ln r on consecutive rungs of the nested surface-graded family (cell ratio r = 2); Richardson extrapolate f3 + e32/(r^p - 1); GCI_fine = 1.25 |e32/f3|/(r^p - 1) (Roache); reported only when the two differences share a sign and decrease

faner_ladder.method: observed order p = ln(e21/e32)/ln r on consecutive rungs of the nested surface-graded family (cell ratio r = 2); Richardson extrapolate f3 + e32/(r^p - 1); GCI_fine = 1.25 |e32/f3|/(r^p - 1) (Roache); reported only when the two differences share a sign and decrease
faner_ladder.note: outlet quantities at the prescribed 240 s; the Faner readings of the manuscript (feed end, falling interval, core end, misfits) are in paper/analysis/manuscript_numbers/faner_r15/ladder_r15.json
